app.title: Sloth Welcome
window.title: Welcome to Sloth OS
welcome.heading: Welcome to Sloth OS!
welcome.text: A few quick questions and your computer is ready. You can change everything later.
look.colors_hint: Click one to see it right away. You can change it later in System Settings.
layout.windows10.name: Windows 10
layout.windows10.description: Start menu and icons on the left
layout.windows11.name: Windows 11
layout.windows11.description: Start menu and icons in the center
layout.mac.name: macOS-like
layout.mac.description: Top bar, floating dock at the bottom
security.heading: When should your computer ask for your password?
security.text: Some settings (such as installing programs) ask for your password. That way nobody can change your computer without you knowing.
security.all: Ask for every change (the most secure)
security.recommended: Only for risky things: disks, users, startup (more convenient)
security.not_admin: Only an administrator account can change this.
security.autologin: Sign in automatically: start straight to the desktop without a password
security.later: You can fine-tune this later in Sloth Center (Account and security).
category.multiple: You can pick several, or none.
category.browser.name: Web browser
category.browser.hint: This is how you get online. Without a browser you can't open websites.
category.office.name: Office
category.office.hint: Documents, spreadsheets, presentations. Opens Word and Excel files too.
category.media.name: Music and video
category.chat.name: Chat
category.games.name: Games
category.games.hint: Game stores and launchers. Windows games and programs also run without them.
category.creative.name: Creativity
category.creative.hint: Photo editing, drawing, video editing, recording.
app.com.google.Chrome: Google's browser, syncs with your Google account
app.com.microsoft.Edge: The browser you know from Windows
app.app.zen_browser.zen: Clean and simple, based on Firefox
app.com.vivaldi.Vivaldi: Lots of ways to customize it
app.com.opera.Opera: With a built-in VPN and messengers
app.org.chromium.Chromium: The open source base of Chrome
app.com.wps.Office: Office-like interface with lots of templates
app.org.kde.haruna: Simple video player that fits the system
app.com.heroicgameslauncher.hgl: Epic Games, GOG and Amazon games
app.net.lutris.Lutris: Many other game stores and older games
app.ai.storyteller.artcraft-launcher: All the Craft apps (PhotoCraft, FilmCraft…) in one place
offline.text: No internet connection. Connect to a network to install apps.
nobrowser.title: You didn't pick a browser
nobrowser.text: Without a browser you can't open websites. Are you sure?
install.note: Depending on your connection, this may take a few minutes.
error.network: No internet connection, or the server can't be reached.
error.disk_full: There isn't enough free disk space.
error.not_authorized: We didn't get permission to install.
error.checksum: The downloaded file was damaged, so we didn't install it.
done.nothing_selected: All done! You can install apps later in Discover.
done.all_ok: All done! Your apps are waiting in the Start menu.
done.some_failed: Almost done. Some apps couldn't be installed:
done.all_failed: Sorry, the apps couldn't be installed right now:
done.retry_hint: You can try again later by opening “Sloth Welcome” from the Start menu.
done.extras: A couple more things, if you like:
desktop.comment: Install a browser, office suite, media player and more, pick a color theme
